answer: Each epoch a beacon spot-checks 5% of identities with a heartbeat: answer a challenge on one live thread within 60 seconds. A glacier-slow identity missing the deadline is frozen, its 40-unit bond slashed. Keeping 100 fakes warm costs 4,000 units per epoch against 30 units of reward each, a payback that never arrives. Honest agents pay 40 once and keep full rewards; identities that wander to a new address are caught, the beacon follows the bond.
